# Periodic-FSK negative that v3 classified as LoRa

English · [简体中文](说明.md)

`provenance.json` records the independent generator's deterministic seed, original hash and crop interval. This is synthetic periodic FSK, without LoRa or an actual RF capture. v3 emitted a LoRa structure; the subsequent direction-change verification must reject it. One fixed negative cannot estimate a field false-positive rate.
